<a name="support-policy"></a>
## Support Policy

For all Laravel releases, bug fixes are provided for 18 months and security fixes are provided for 2 years.

- **Laravel 13**: PHP 8.3 to 8.5, released March 17th, 2026, security fixes until March 17th, 2028
- **Laravel 12**: PHP 8.2 to 8.5, released February 24th, 2025, security fixes until February 24th, 2027
